fusions.name: Tumbling Ram
fusions.desc: Rolls you up to 6 tiles into the target for 15 damage, leaving it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Scale Spin
fusions.desc: Spins a ring of scales that deals 4 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Tight Shoal
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Scale Ledger
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 stacks they all spend at once, giving you a shield that soaks 8% of your maximum health per stack (46% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. Your armour also rises by 6%.
